channel.title: Elreda Advertising Blog
channel.description: The Elreda Advertising blog: practical guides for businesses in Egypt and the UAE on e-invoicing, logo and visual identity design, print-ready files, online stores, and software and AI solutions.

item.title: E-Invoicing in the UAE: Deadlines, Requirements and How to Prepare
item.description: A guide to mandatory e-invoicing in the UAE: go-live dates for each group, Accredited Service Providers (ASPs), the 5-corner model and PINT AE, readiness steps, and how it differs from Egypt's system.

item.title: Building an Online Store in Egypt: Platform, Payments and Shipping, Step by Step
item.description: How to build an online store that actually sells in Egypt: choosing between Shopify, WooCommerce and a custom store, payment methods (cards, Meeza, Fawry, wallets and cash on delivery), shipping and returns, and a launch checklist.

item.title: Software Solutions for Business: When You Need Automation or a Custom System, and Where AI Helps
item.description: Signs your company needs a software solution, the difference between off-the-shelf software, automation and a custom system, tasks worth automating, where AI genuinely helps, and how to start a project without it getting out of hand.

item.title: Connecting to Egypt's E-Invoice System: Steps and Requirements
item.description: A practical guide to connecting to the Egyptian Tax Authority's e-invoice system: who must join, the documents you need, the electronic signature, EGS and GS1 item codes, connecting an accounting system, and the most common reasons invoices are rejected.

item.title: 5 Common Logo Design Mistakes That Weaken Your Brand (and How to Avoid Them)
item.description: The 5 mistakes that weaken a logo most: too much detail, too many colours, hard-to-read type, a single version and a JPG-only file, with simple tests, a checklist before approving your logo, and the files you should receive.

item.title: Before You Send Your File to the Printer: a 6-Point Checklist for Print Without Surprises
item.description: How to prepare a design file for print: CMYK colour, 300 DPI, 3 mm bleed, safe margins, embedded fonts and a proof, with a table of common sizes, paper weights and finishes.
